sentences.text:
After going through the statements of the witnesses,
more particularly, the evidence of P.W.5 and the medical evidence, we are not inclined to accept the prayer for suspension of sentence of the Applicant.

However,
considering the fact that the Applicant is in jail since last nine and half years and in view of the request made by the learned Counsel for the Applicant, we are inclined to grant him expeditious hearing of the connected Appeal.

Registry, to therefore, list the Appeal in the 3 rd week of September, 2025 under the caption 'for final hearing'
subject to availability of the paper book.
5) Interim Application stands disposed of in above terms.

(SHYAM C. CHANDAK, J.)
